content: Considering the different natures of explicit vs. implicit discourse relation prediction, we decide to untie parameters at the final discourse relation prediction layer and train two softmax classifiers, as illustrated in Figure 2 . The two classifiers have different sets of parameters, with one classifier for only implicit discourse relations and the other for only explicit discourse relations.
